correctness.rationale: The assigned geometric snub-cube model in the exact cubic ring Z[t]/(t³−t²−t−1) constructs precisely 24 distinct labelled vertices, 60 edges and degree five; edge squared distance is exactly 2+4t−2t². Independently reconstructed all 5,301 nonempty independent sets with f-vector (24,216,912,1854,1680,564,48,3); staged toggling at order (13v+22) mod24 gives exactly 2,628 matched pairs and critical-cell counts one 0-cell, nine 3-cells and 35 4-cells. A separate oriented Hasse topological sort visits all 5,301 cells and 22,728 incidences, hence matching is acyclic. Integer-valued recursive algebraic Morse cancellation computes a 9×35 signed critical boundary; the fixed nine columns (7,19,20,26,28,1,18,29,10) have determinant −1, so D is split-surjective over Z. The 3-skeleton is ∨9 S³ and its 4-cell attaching homotopy classes in π3(∨9 S³)=Z9 are completely represented by the signed boundary; 9 elementary attaching pairs cancel and 26 S4 remain. This proves INTEGRAL homotopy equivalence, not just finite-field homology.
residual_risks: The theorem applies only to the exactly specified chiral snub cubical 24-vertex graph; face enumeration is exhaustive for this finite graph, not a family induction.
